description: This file defines a custom exception class BeneficiaryTransferLimitExceededException used within the Fineract project, specifically in the self account portfolio domain. It extends a core platform exception class and represents an error condition when a transfer amount exceeds the limit for a beneficiary.

classes.name: BeneficiaryTransferLimitExceededException
classes.description: A custom exception representing an error when a beneficiary transfer amount exceeds the allowed limit.

methods.name: BeneficiaryTransferLimitExceededException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code and message indicating transfer limit exceeded.
